headline: President Clinton created a group of federal agencies to review what jobs the U.S. Coast Guard should do.
what_it_does: This 1999 executive order set up an interagency task force to study the roles and missions of the U.S. Coast Guard. Based on the title, the group was meant to look at the Coast Guard's duties and give advice about them. No summary was provided, so details about who served on the task force, its deadlines, or its final report are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. Coast Guard members and leadership
who_it_affects.how: Their agency's duties and missions were the subject of the task force's review.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work with the Coast Guard
who_it_affects.how: They were likely asked to take part in the task force, though the title alone does not say which agencies.
